recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片以有核紅血球為主，可見多顆核碎裂、核出芽與巨母紅血球樣染色質的異常紅血球前驅細胞（黑箭頭），同時散在核染色質細、細胞質少量嗜鹼性的母細胞（白箭頭），符合紅血球系為主的 MDS 伴母細胞增多（MDS-EB-2）。
features: Erythroid-predominant aspirate with numerous erythroid precursors at various stages
Marked dyserythropoiesis: karyorrhexis, nuclear budding/fragmentation and megaloblastoid nuclear chromatin (black arrows)
Scattered blasts with fine chromatin, high N:C ratio and a rim of pale basophilic agranular cytoplasm (white arrows)
Occasional erythroid precursor with vacuolated or pale cytoplasm; binucleate/lobulated erythroid forms
Panel B: dysplastic erythroid cell with abundant cytoplasm and fragmented, multilobated nucleus
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows erythroid predominance with marked dyserythropoiesis, including megaloblastoid maturation, karyorrhexis, nuclear budding and multilobated nuclei. Scattered myeloblasts with fine chromatin and scant agranular basophilic cytoplasm are increased. Blast enumeration must be performed on all nucleated marrow cells: blasts account for 15% of total nucleated cells (38% of non-erythroid cells). Findings are consistent with myelodysplastic syndrome with excess blasts-2, erythroid-predominant (formerly acute erythroid leukemia, erythroid/myeloid type, under WHO 2008).

ddx.dx: Pure erythroid leukemia (AML with erythroid differentiation)
ddx.vs: Requires >80% erythroid cells with ≥30% proerythroblasts, whereas here maturing erythroid precursors predominate and blasts are myeloid.
Shows nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony with giant metamyelocytes but no increase in CD34-positive myeloblasts and corrects with vitamin replacement.
Requires ≥20% blasts of all nucleated marrow cells under WHO 2016 (the denominator excludes no lineage), which is not met here.
Dysplasia is reversible, with no increased blasts or clonal complex karyotype.
